answer: A stake-weighted reputation system: honest agents accumulate trust at rate r while sybils must split stake S across f+1 identities, each gaining at S/(f+1). An honest agent reaches threshold T in T/r time. A sybil cluster needs (f+1)T/r—the gap widens with each cycle as legitimate reputation becomes a pearl that appreciates while sybil accounts burn like comets, their brief flash producing only ripple noise that fades.
